QuestInfo.name: One-Stop Event Info
QuestInfo.0: Events have always been a great way for players to delve deeper into Maple World. Now, finding events is easier than ever! Talk to #b#p9010000##k.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p9010000##k told you how important events are to the culture of Maple World. She also told you how to learn about events more easily.\nBy checking the #b#eEvent List#n#k, you can see events in progress, and join them directly.
